r: pbmtoatk - convert a PBM image to a Andrew Toolkit raster object

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

pbmtoatk reads a PBM image as input and produces a Andrew Toolkit raster object as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for pbmtoatk, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
